metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: FUJICHROME PROVIA 400X Professional [RXP] Fujifilm Product Information Bulletin, Ref. No. AF3-0213E, as published by Fujifilm (no year printed on the curve page), PDF page 7 (spectral sensitivity, per-dye spectral density, characteristic curves; RMS granularity 11). PDF sha256 06204b7e905fabf2c4ad3e77b93008597d85a3d5c51a3f41cd176e1ee919e4c0. Data (c) FUJIFILM Corporation. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/fujifilm-reversal/fujifilm_provia_400x/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), its steps for positive films: D-min removed (base synthesised from the curves' D-min), log E zero where green is 0.735 over D-min, Fujifilm's own per-dye spectra scaled so equal amounts view as an 18.4 % neutral under the viewing illuminant, status-A unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, each channel aligned so log E 0 develops its metameric-neutral amount, and spektrafilm's slide grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 at data_trustability 1.0. hanatos2025 adaptation window [433.5, 28.3, 606.2, 59.3] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md D11.
Negs slide neutralisation (tools/film_profiles/neutralise_positive.py, a Negs step, not spektrafilm's): the red and blue curve models are moved so a grey card filmed at EV -3 to +2.5 and scanned stays neutral, while the status-A densities stay within about 0.10 D (or their deviation before the step, if larger; a soft limit) of the datasheet's characteristic curves, the curves change as little as possible and the DIR pre-correction does not fold; green is not touched. Weights tuned on Provia 100F and tested on Velvia 100, Ektachrome 100 and Kodachrome 64 (data/profile-sources/fujifilm-reversal/calibration/neutralisation_test.json). For this film: grey-ramp neutrality (EV -1 to +2) 0.0316 before, 0.0015 after; largest colour of the ramp C*ab 2.89 before, 2.28 after; largest curve change 0.048 D; worst status-A deviation from the datasheet 0.123 D (before 0.122 D).
Negs choices: reference illuminant D55 (daylight stock, exposed at 5400 K); viewing illuminant D50; no target print (a slide is viewed or scanned); log_sensitivity_density_over_min 1.0 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves in log10 H as printed; use 'still' and antihalation 'strong' as the shipped spektrafilm Velvia 100 and Provia 100F; DIR couplers: its own table, the class default scaled uniformly so the DIR pre-correction does not fold (D8).
